title: Yellowed Creamy German Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and comforting German lamb stew with a floral and creamy twist, perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat and season the lamb shoulder pieces with salt, black pepper, and caraway seeds.
Grill the lamb pieces for 5 minutes per side, or until browned, then set aside.
In a large kazan-cauldron, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
Add the grilled lamb pieces, chicken broth, and dried thyme to the cauldron and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the heavy cream and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste, then serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the stew in bowls and enjoy with a side of crusty bread or over egg noodles.
